programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: Domi Kids is a brand-new 3D animated musical series created by Leqing Media. With lively and engaging music, multiple characters bring to life the warm and joyful daily adventures of Domi and his family of five. The show features diverse themes, captivating stories, and vibrant scenes. A professional music production team ensures high-quality melodies, arrangements, and vocals, creating a delightful audiovisual experience for children. With positive and entertaining content, the series helps young kids learn about the world at an age-appropriate pace while supporting parents in making parenting easier and more enjoyable.

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Baby Riki
programme.desc: The show covers all aspects of a child’s life from physical well-being to cognitive and soft skills. The musical stories are based around age-appropriate experiences with educational concepts introduced in familiar surroundings and context for infants.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Get ready to watch Talking Tom and Friends at their cutest! Mini in size, but massive in fun, the Minis check out the day-to-day world of the friends we all know and love where they do the most ordinary things in the most extraordinary ways.

programme.title: Leo the Wildlife Ranger
programme.desc: Leo the Wildlife Ranger introduces the secrets and wonders of nature and wildlife around us and kickstarts a curiosity and passion for nature in kids. With engaging missions and adventures, kids have fun while learning positive lessons!

programme.title: Counting With Paula
programme.desc: The show features Paula and her friends, Tim, Billy, Chalky, Calc, and the Numbers as they go on exciting adventures in colorful and exotic places. From the Amazon jungles to the deepest oceans, and to the hottest deserts, Paula and friends solve problems, have fun and make more friends along the way!

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons
programme.desc: Check out Angry Birds Toons compilations! Each compilation has several episodes from your favorite shows including Angry Birds, Piggy Tales, and Stella!

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Missing
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Without A Trace
programme.desc: Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A janitor-turned-gunfighter's reputation hangs on one lucky shot and a lot of gall. The handyman finds himself in trouble when he accidentally kills another gunfighter.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas tries to get help when he is shot after witnessing a murder.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: After being foreman of a jury that convicted an Apache, Lucas is marked for death. Now, he must discover who is behind the curse.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas allows some snowed-in stagecoach passengers to stay with him until the roads are passable. Trouble brews when the whiskey salesman and gunfighter fall for the same woman.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Two pranksters write away for a mail-order bride, using Lucas's name.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas recognizes Dr. Battle as an ex-gunslinger with whom he once fought. He helps with a dying man, but Lucas and the doctor have unresolved anger.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A Chinese man and his son fight prejudice as they try to open a laundry in North Fork.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: While Lucas and Mark are traveling across the Mexican desert they encounter a trio of Mexican bandits who demand payment to cross "their" desert.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark takes a job as a stable boy against his father's wishes.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark and Milly are held hostage in her general store when two gunmen attempt a daring robbery.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Two prison wagon drivers stop at the McCain ranch looking for whiskey. Lucas turns them down because they are escorting a murderer, to be hanged in Yuma.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark goes to work for Will Temple, a badly scarred, very mysterious rancher.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Corey Hazlett insists he's innocent of murder, despite Lucas's eyewitness testimony.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas tries to dissuade a latter-day knight from rushing into battle.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Abe Lincoln's claim that he's the Great Emancipator amuses everyone except Matt Yordy.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Stubborn Grandpa Fogarty is Lucas's main roadblock as he tries to get young Woody Fogarty to attend school.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark Twain visits North Fork and quickly alienates the townspeople.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas tries to stop embittered John Holliver from venting his wrath on the people who expelled him from town years before.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas becomes the target of a vengeful mountaineer after he is responsible for a young mountain boy's death.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When Mark is kidnapped and held for ransom, he finds himself an unwilling companion of gunman Carl Avery.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas seeks an escape when he's captured by outlaws while seeking help for an injured Mark.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The young Queen-to-be of France hides out in North Fork with her sick brother.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A notorious killer is being held in the North Fork jail. When word gets around that Gordo's gang is on its way to free him, the whole town becomes frightened.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas's old Army pal settles in North Fork with his deaf daughter.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: An Englishman arrives with a custom-made rifle and a plan to kill Lucas.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark falls head-over-heels in puppy love.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Banker Hamilton is closing up for the day when Rudy Gray persuades him to stay open for one more transaction...a withdrawal at gunpoint.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Tip Corey, the son of a man allegedly murdered in North Fork, has a killer's reputation and comes to town to kill Micah.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Len Richards and his brother, Ab, confront a Lucas McCain look-alike, Earl Bantry and his sidekick K.C. Peters, for slaughtering one of Richards' steers.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark stop on the way to the county fair to deliver a message to Micah, who is escorting a prisoner to be hanged. Mark and Lucas recognize the prisoner.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol y Pamela hacen un trato de borrón y cuenta nueva en nombre de sus amigos. Aaron, Jerry, Lydia y Elijah se marchan hacia Oceanside para hablarles de un plan. La Commonwealth celebra el Día de los Fundadores.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Eugene huye después del incidente del Día de los Fundadores. Pamela le pide a Mercer que investigue dónde está, para disgusto de Max y La Princesa. Por otro lado, Aaron, Jerry, Lydia y Elijah se topan con un contratiempo peculiar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Carol investigan el paradero de sus amigos después de que Pamela los hiciera desaparecer de la Commonwealth. Por desgracia, su única pista es Hornsby. Por otro lado, Pamela le pide a Yumiko que procese a Eugene en nombre de la Commonwealth.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Después de separarse de sus hijos, Maggie, Gabriel y Rosita siguen un convoy militar hasta un destino misterioso. Ezekiel, Kelly, Negan y Annie acaban en una zona de obras. Daryl y Carol siguen a un tren que lleva a Connie a bordo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Ezequiel y Negan organizan una revuelta clandestina contra los guardianes. Aarón, Jerry, Lydia y Elijah se unen a Luke y a Jules durante su huida a la costa. Además, Eugene es juzgado con el apoyo de Yumiko como abogada defensora.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los alejandrinos y los prisioneros vuelven a la Commonwealth para enfrentarse a Pamela Milton. Por otro lado, una horda se acerca a la ciudad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Carol llevan a Judith al hospital, mientras que Rosita, Eugene y Gabriel buscan a Coco. Por otro lado, Maggie y Negan se enfrentan a Pamela y los héroes se reúnen para una última batalla.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick Grimes, policía de una pequeña localidad de Georgia, despierta de un coma y repentinamente se encuentra en un mundo apocalíptico. Desorientado, en busca de su familia y una explicación a lo acontecido, Rick ha de adaptarse al nuevo orden.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick llega a caballo a Atlanta, donde encuentra una ciudad desolada. Tras escapar de una situación de peligro, Rick se une a un grupo de supervivientes en unos grandes almacenes, donde le espera un enemigo más peligroso que los zombis.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick regresa a Atlanta al sentirse culpable de haber dejado a Merle abandonado en un edificio asolado por zombis. En el campamento, la inesperada llegada de Rick causa tensión entre Lori y Shane, quien había asegurado que Rick había muerto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En Atlanta, una banda armada sorprende al grupo de Rick mientras están buscando a Merle. Entretanto, en el campamento, Jim empieza a comportarse de forma extraña, tiene premoniciones y asusta a los niños con una tragedia que se aproxima.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras el ataque al campamento, Rick conduce al grupo hacia el CDC, un recinto de la base sanitaria militar, en el que esperan encontrar un refugio seguro. Durante el trayecto, Jim debe tomar una decisión extremadamente difícil.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Un científico inquietante deja entrar a Rick y su grupo en el CDC. No obstante, hay algo extraño y los supervivientes del apocalipsis zombi empiezan a sospechar que no todo es lo que parece en el recinto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo, liderado por Rick, se topa con una horda de zombis en mitad de la autopista. La pequeña Sophia, asustada, huye sola al bosque y todos tratarán de encontrarla antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Las hermanitas Calle
programme.desc: La familia se apellida Calle. Son 4 hermanas, 1 hermano, la mamá, un tío y los novios. Dos de las hermanas son cantantes populares y consiguen un contrato discográfico, pero todos los miembros de la familia, incluyéndolas, atraviesan situaciones dramáticas. Tienen que enfrentar muchos problemas que no dejan de aparecer. Las dos protagonistas son las hermanas cantantes. Además, deben enfrentarse al alcalde corrupto y malvado, quien acusa falsamente a una de ellas y hace que termine en la cárcel.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une fille mystérieuse
programme.desc: Las d'entendre les critiques de Raph, Léo laisse son frère diriger l'équipe. Pendant ce temps, Léo rencontre une belle et dangereuse kunoïchi.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Roi des Rats
programme.desc: Les tortues doivent faire face à nouvel ennemi, le Roi des Rats, qui menace de prendre le contrôle de la ville, mais aussi de l'esprit de Splinter.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le plan des Krangs
programme.desc: Quand les devoirs d'école d'April attirent l'attention des Krangs, les tortues prennent le lycée d'assaut.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Pulvériseur
programme.desc: Les tortues ont un problème avec le Pulvériseur, un adolescent qui se prend pour un héros et qui veut combattre le crime à leurs côtés.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mystère au TCRI
programme.desc: En s'introduisant dans l'enceinte très surveillée du TCRI, les tortues découvrent les véritables intentions des Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le cafard Terminator
programme.desc: Alors qu'elles tentent de déjouer le plan d'invasion de la Terre par les Krangs, les tortues sont pourchassées par un cafard géant et indestructible.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le labyrinthe de la peur
programme.desc: Fatigué d'être humilié par Fishface et Dogpound, et de perdre face aux tortues, Baxter Stockman prépare sa vengeance.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'ennemi de mon ennemi
programme.desc: Après avoir vu les Krangs à l'œuvre, Karai propose une alliance aux tortues. Mais est-elle digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La mission de Karaï
programme.desc: Le clan des Foot tente de capturer April, qui doit combattre Karaï si elle veut leur échapper.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Pulvériseur
programme.desc: Quand Shredder projette de créer une armée de mutants, les tortues demandent l'aide de leur plus grand fan.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'œuf
programme.desc: Leonardo, Raphael et Donatello deviennent les esclaves d'une guêpe mutante. Leur sort dépend de leur frère Michelangelo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une évasion à haut risque
programme.desc: April reçoit un message codé. Pendant que ses frères dorment, Donatello tente de le déchiffrer. C'est Kirby O'Neil, le père d'April, qui appelle à l'aide...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Les Krangs s'apprêtent à lancer la phase finale de l'invasion de la Terre. Ils préparent l'arrivée du Technodrome depuis la dimension X, qui se fera par le portail.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 2e partie
programme.desc: Leonardo a survécu à l'explosion du dernier étage du TCRI, mais n'a pu empêcher le passage du Technodrome par le portail. L'immense vaisseau en forme de sphère sème la terreur sur la ville, en tirant à vue et enlevant des humains...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutation accidentelle
programme.desc: C'est la fête chez les Tortues Ninja, mais malheureusement, ça ne va pas durer longtemps ! Les tortues ont répandu accidentellement une cargaison de tubes de mutagène au-dessus de la ville.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Qui est le chef ?
programme.desc: Les tortues parcourent la ville à la recherche des tubes de mutagène grâce au détecteur de fluides de Donnie. Karai repère leur manège et décide de leur tendre un piège...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion des écureuils-mutants
programme.desc: Tandis qu'elles parcourent la ville à la recherche de tubes de mutagène, les tortues tombent sur un sans-abri au comportement étrange. Il est aux prises avec un écureuil très agressif, qui finit par se faufiler dans son estomac...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutagène-man se déchaîne
programme.desc: Pendant que ses frères regardent un dessin animé débile sur une vieille cassette vidéo, Donatello se confie à Timothy, transformé en mutant et conservé dans un tube dans son labo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'acné mutante de Mikey
programme.desc: Un beau matin, Mikey se réveille avec des boutons sur tout le corps, ou presque. Pris de panique, il va voir ses frères qui tentent de le rassurer. En retour, il avoue avoir saupoudré un dérivé de mutagène sur sa peau pour devenir plus cool...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une cible nommée April O'Neil
programme.desc: Shredder a eu vent du comportement de Karaï durant son absence et lui ordonne de ne plus s'allier aux Krangs. Mais ces derniers ont fabriqué le successeur des Foot-bots, et Karaï veut absolument se le procurer afin d'éliminer April...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Slash la tortue
programme.desc: Raphael s'agace. Il n'en peut plus d'avoir des frères qui passent leur temps à plaisanter et à jouer, ou à faire des gaffes. Cette fois, l'une des expériences de Donnie tourne mal, et Spike manque d'y laisser sa carapace...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La conspiration des Krangs
programme.desc: Pendant leur entraînement quotidien, les tortues et April se sentent observées. Elles poursuivent l'espion jusqu'à sa cachette, afin de le démasquer. Il s'agit d'un dénommé Kurtzman, journaliste de son métier, qui enquête sur la conspiration des Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones
programme.sub-title: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones
programme.desc: Après s'être disputé avec ses frères, Raphael va prendre l'air pour évacuer sa colère.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Fungus Monstruosus
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja découvrent d'étranges champignons dans les égoûts de New York. Ce sont des champignons mutants, qui ont avalé du mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête d'acier Version 2.0
programme.desc: Donatello pense avoir réparé et amélioré Tête d'Acier, mais le robot continue d'avoir des bugs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Des rats et des hommes
programme.desc: Le Roi des Rats a créé un sérum de croissance au mutagène qu'il a injecté à ses rats. Ceux-ci enlèvent des humains, destinés à devenir une armée d'hommes-rats. Casey et Irma, une amie d'April, sont kidnappés et enfermés dans des cages dans les égoûts

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 1
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 2
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.sub-title: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Shredder met sa menace à exécution et fait exploser le collier de mutagène de Baxter Stockman, toujours incapable de lui fournir une armée de mutants digne de ce nom. Stockman mute en mouche et devient Stockman la mouche.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Tritonateur
programme.desc: Raph trouve que son partenaire Casey n'est pas à la hauteur. De mystérieux justiciers éliminent les Krangs : il s'agit de Slash, l'ex-tortue Spike de Raph et du Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La colère de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Shredder confie à Tiger Claw la mission de détruire les tortues. Karai doit leur tendre un piège. Elle réussit à convaincre April qu'elle est du côté des tortues.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête de pizza
programme.desc: Changement de propriétaire chez Antonio, le roi des pizzas. Le nouveau chef est un mutant, à tête de pizza. Tous les clients qui consomment ses créations sont changés en zombies, destinés à finir roulés en calzone dans l'estomac du mutant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende du Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Steranko, un obscur marchand d'armes borgne, est à la recherche d'un objet qui viendra compléter sa collection d'armures. Il s'agit du « Kuro Kabuto », le casque de Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Plan 10
programme.desc: Les Krangs testent une nouvelle machine pour envahir la Terre, qui consiste à permuter les cerveaux. Ils pourront ainsi manœuvrer les leaders terriens et parvenir à leurs fins.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le goût de la vengeance
programme.desc: Karai est enfermée dans les prisons de Shredder. Les tortues la font évader et la ramènent au repaire. Splinter lui explique l'histoire de la guerre entre le Clan des Foot et la famille Hamato.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.
